text.p: - Russia's biggest state insurance company "Rosgosstrakh" is about to be privatised without much publicity and at a very moderate price.
- International space programmes demonstrate the problems of the Russian aerospace industry.
- The Federation Council, the upper house of Russian parliament, approved the 1997 budget, although it was viewed as unrealistic by many deputies.
- The Russian government and the International Monetary Fund are about to enter a new period of tension in relations.

- The time of "the dialogue of the deaf" is over in Russia-NATO relations, the period of real, difficult negotiations starts now, says Vladimir Lukin, chairman of the international committee of the State Duma.
- President Yeltsin's annual address to parliament should be brief, precise and tough, says former finance minister Boris Fyodorov.
- An opinion poll shows that the more one drinks, the stronger supporter of the present authorities one is.
- The Russian government is selling its last reserves of rare metals abroad. This will bring Russian hi-tech industry to a halt.
